description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements logging functionalities by wrapping Android's native Log utility. It provides a way to connect multiple log nodes into a chain, allowing logs to be forwarded downstream.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: Implements the LogNode interface to provide a logging wrapper around Android's native Log utility, supporting chainable logging nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs messages using Android's native log, and forwards the log to the next node if present.
